name: masked-input
title: Masked input
description: A text input that formats as you type from a simple pattern such as (###) ###-#### or AA-####, with a caret that never jumps.
docs: mask: # is a digit, A a letter (made a capital), * a letter or a digit, a backslash makes the next character a literal, and anything else is written for you. value and onValueChange(raw, formatted, { complete }) work with the bare characters. showMask draws the unfilled part as quiet text, and definitions adds tokens such as { H: /[0-9a-f]/i } or replaces #, A and *. inputMode is numeric when the mask only takes digits. The field is not controlled by React, because the caret has to be set by hand after every edit; name posts the formatted text.
